scope: TC0-A rows and the G0 core-readiness rows G1 depends on, for the pure-call demo (schemas /1 and /2)

statuses.DEVELOPMENT-EVIDENCE: Retained development evidence exists for the stated scope; it is not a verdict
statuses.UNKNOWN: Required evidence is missing or incomplete
statuses.DEFERRED-TO-B-C: Belongs to a later slice; never satisfies an A row

rows.requirement: Selected Shen/process toolchain baseline and pinned source inventory
gaps: x86-64 Linux only (shen-scheme v0.26 ships one binary)
The native-host epoch (Solo5 images, C toolchain) is separate and not opened
Node and Python used by checks are whatever runs them; the flake's devShell pins them but nothing enforces its use

rows.requirement: Exact I64 values, intermediates and unsigned IDs against independently established integers, per relied-on Shen port
gaps: Finite boundary product (2908 programs per port), not all I64 pairs
Bound into the registered TC0-A evaluator manifest; fresh gate evidence is required for each source identity

rows.requirement: Enforced evaluator boundary: candidates cannot write protected inputs, read credentials or reach the network
gaps: Covers the candidate peer only; the regression suite runs with network and environment isolation only
CPU, memory and time are bounded by watchdogs, not the sandbox
No independent review; not a qualified isolation claim

rows.requirement: Versioned requirement ledger
gaps: Not independently reviewed
This evidence ledger is referenced by the registered evaluator manifest; it does not issue qualification verdicts

rows.requirement: Canonical transport: decimal strings, sorted keys, escapes, duplicate-key and UTF-8 rejection, byte hashing
Reject malformed, unsupported, ill-typed, non-exhaustive/duplicate-arm and invalid-entry artifacts; caps yield ValidationLimit; invalid artifacts never execute
gaps: Invalid family is 27 named single mutations of one seed, not exhaustive invalid-program exploration
Region checks are not exercised in A (no regions)

rows.requirement: Immutable values; aliases never change
A-slice types and built-ins: Unit/Bool/I64/Bytes/TrapCode, tuples, datatypes, construct/match/project, arithmetic, comparisons, not, bytes_length/bytes_index/bytes_concat, eq
gaps: Outcome, SendResult and ReceiveResult families belong to C

rows.requirement: Strict left-to-right operand evaluation; a trapping operand prevents later operands; if/match select exactly one branch
Tail calls do not increase semantic continuation depth
gaps: Semantic continuation depth only; native stack usage is a P5 obligation

rows.requirement: Normative reference-step staging with a versioned, hashed transition catalog exercised by one-step evidence
gaps: Catalog not independently reviewed
Coverage is per named transition (112/112), not every frame/context combination

rows.requirement: Closure descriptors {code_id, captures, capture_support: []} with captures in increasing binding-ID order
Strict replay from the first slice: singleton decisions, epochs, sites, full trace and exact footers; drift fails closed
Termination on the last permitted step is Completed; a further runnable step is BudgetExhausted
Exploration identity and ExhaustiveWithinBounds claims
gaps: A has one scheduling alternative per state, so exploration is over programs (every program of grammar G up to 5 nodes), not interleavings
No property monitors yet

rows.requirement: Generated discovery of an implementation failure, typed reduction with fresh model confirmation, exact original and minimized replay
gaps: Smallest-found, not globally minimal

rows.requirement: One independently built candidate-only repair with fresh passing evidence
gaps: Repairer isolation was instruction-only (local subagent), not enforced
Repairer shares a model family with the packet author
One small, local defect

rows.requirement: Reversed-operands candidate mutant killed with the expected classification and a retained reproducer
Bad-overflow candidate mutant killed
gaps: Killed by trace divergence in the exhaustive scope; no reduced, retained reproducer yet

rows.requirement: Ignored replay-domain mismatch detected
Early-terminal contradiction detected
gaps: Scripted peer at the replay layer; a fabricated trace that also fakes every later step is out of scope by design (02 §16)

rows.requirement: Unknown-to-pass promotion rejected
gaps: Controller-level only (unknown and unresolved cleanup stop instead of pass); this row does not establish evaluator-level classification coverage

rows.requirement: Host-time read detected
gaps: 02 §16: runtime/time mutants start in C. A has no time semantics, and the sandbox does not deny clock reads

rows.requirement: Explicit Shen model; candidate imports no Shen transitions; port agreement claims only portability
Aggregate verdicts from a versioned requirement manifest with fresh source-bound evidence
gaps: Owner-reviewed and registered under recorded waivers: instruction-only repairer isolation, current scopes and a trusted-local evaluator
The ledger records evidence, not verdicts; the registered gate issues them

rows.requirement: Structured tasks and bounded channels: the model and an independent implementation agree step for step under every recorded schedule, handwritten expectations hold, and the production scheduler refines the reference scheduler (the commuting obligation, CONCURRENCY.md §9)
gaps: Draft contract: the provisional choices of CONCURRENCY.md §13 are unconfirmed by the owner
No reduction, strict replay or hashed transition catalog for tasks, and no Solo5 guest or frontend for them
Exhaustive only over grammar G (2-3 tasks, one or two channels of capacity 1-2); no generated programs beyond it
Fixtures, both machines and the harness share one author lineage
Bounded exploration, development grade; not a proof that the production scheduler refines the reference scheduler

rows.requirement: Host-controlled Solo5 guest: the Shen host drives the stock tender step by step over the control protocol, compares every step with the model, stops at the first divergence, records tapes and replays them strictly, and fails closed on hostile peers
gaps: Scope is the hand cases, the TC1 handler fixtures and every 25th program of the 5-node exhaustive grammar, not the whole family
The guest images are built by JavaScript tooling the harness trusts only to produce its inputs
Needs Solo5 at the pinned commit; where it is not built the evidence cannot be produced
Covers the pure-call machine and TC1 handler fixtures; not tasks or channels

rows.requirement: Durable effects discharged by the host: the Shen model and an independent implementation agree step for step on the hand fixtures under their host replies, a host-controlled Solo5 guest over control protocol v2 agrees with the model and refuses contract-violating replies, injected durable defects are detected, and the validator edit that admits the durable schema changes no earlier verdict
gaps: Draft contract: the owner choices of DURABLE.md §12 are unconfirmed
Hand fixtures only (16): no generated or exhaustive family and no reduction of a failure, and no strict replay of retained failures or hashed transition catalog for the durable machine
Capabilities are forgeable values in D1 (DURABLE.md §9, §12 item 11)
Fixtures, the model, the implementation and the harness share one author lineage
The validator differential compares only with the validator before the D1 edit, on the existing corpora and six mutation kinds
Needs Solo5 at the pinned commit for the guest evidence; no tasks, volatile host effects or host-initiated discontinue (DURABLE.md §11)

rows.requirement: Typing of TC1 artifacts stated as named inference rules (rule set R) given to Shen, with a fixed derivation checker; the Shen side derives what the JavaScript validator accepts, rejects what it rejects, and the checker rejects forged derivations
gaps: Derivable under rule set R; soundness (progress, preservation, one-shot judgment implying one-shot behaviour) is not proved
The checker is not proved to implement R; it is short so that it can be read against TYPING.md
Invalid programs are explored only by single-point mutants and boundary probes, not exhaustively
Only the entry input [int, 0]; no effect-row inference at the surface
The JavaScript validator remains the validator of record; the Shen side is a second reading of the same text by one author lineage
Bounded type-safety runs (stepping every accepted program on the model), development grade

rows.requirement: The accepted-job service contract: a Shen model of the Rocq (A0) contract with properties (authority, atomicity, response discipline, retry safety, recovery, conditional progress) checked by bounded exploration with mutants and a JavaScript implementation (A1), and the handler written in Fenrir refining that model (A2)
gaps: The Shen model corresponds to the Rocq A0 model by reading, not by proof (ACCEPTED_JOB.md)
A1 and A2 are bounded exploration (tenants, keys, digests and budgets in the run parameters, with a state cap whose exceeding is a truncation), not exhaustive and not a proof of the properties
Mutants and their predictions are written by the same author lineage as the model; the equivalent control shows only that the monitor does not flag a behaviour-preserving variant
The storage contract (HANDLER.md §3) is the executable store-contract model; its owner choices (HANDLER.md §6) are unconfirmed
The accepted-job contract is not part of slice TC1; the handler runs on the draft TC1-D1 durable effects (TC1-D-DURABLE)

rows.requirement: User effects and handlers
Tasks, scopes, channels, cancellation, resources and virtual time
